question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would be the best cheer captain?

nodes.text: $ZOE endures the mounting pressure! The pyramid holds!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Impressive! I never thought you'd last this long!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We can stop then?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I never said anything about stopping...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Taylor we can't hold this forever!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not expecting you to!
The pyramid begins to teeter...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Everyone disassemble!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's not cheer captain! You can disassemble when `I` say you can!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's not cheer captain! You can disassemble when [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] say you can!

nodes.text: The girls try to hold the pyramid, but can endure no more! The pyramid finally buckles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I haven't even told you the best part...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you become captain, Sam could come back onto the team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Sam? A cheerleader again?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With Taylor demoted and you at the top, you could do whatever you wanted. It would be `so` super fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: With Taylor demoted and you at the top, you could do whatever you wanted. It would be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] super fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That would make Sam really happy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, are you in then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know. I want Sam to be happy, but how are we going to overthrow Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's easy! According to school bylaws, a team captain can be voted out if the team unanimously agrees!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But no one's ever going to agree to vote out Taylor. She's so popular... If we vote her out, she'll destroy us socially!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The funny thing about popularity, $ZOE, is that it's like a house of cards! Pull just one card out, and the whole thing falls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are we going to do to Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have to be honest with you... It's not going to be easy for a goody-goody like you. Are you in or out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm in...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Leave all the details to me! We'll start tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE! You really are too nice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you saw what happened at cheer practice today...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: When I spoke up, no one said `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: When I spoke up, no one said [color=#3b78e2][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But when you spoke up, everyone listened! You're everyone's favorite! Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ew! I'm pretty sure I just threw up in my own mouth!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor is doing everything she can to make `your` life miserable, and what's your reaction?
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor is doing everything she can to make [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] life miserable, and what's your reaction?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't want to hurt her feelings!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How am I supposed to react?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get angry! Be more like your cousin!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, that's right...
The cheerleaders gasp! Everyone stops doing push-ups!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! If `$ZOE` thinks Taylor's out of control, it `must` be true!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! If [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] thinks Taylor's out of control, it [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] be true!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I never thought I'd see the day when `$ZOE` spoke out against Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought I'd see the day when [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] spoke out against Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Push-ups are hard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was just agreeing with Jessica...
Taylor calls out from the bleachers!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! Less chatter! More push-ups!
Jessica whispers...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds like `someone` needs a bf!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] needs a bf!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What was that, Jessica?!
The cheerleaders try to stifle their giggles as Taylor marches down from the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Care to say that again?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't say anything...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know you did. I know you probably said something mean about me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But that's okay, I understand.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Totally! I'd feel bitter too if I didn't even get `nominated` for Homecoming Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Totally! I'd feel bitter too if I didn't even get [color=#3b78e2][i]nominated[/i][/color] for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. Exactly. Why don't you think about what a total failure you are while you're doing your push-ups?
As the girls do their push-ups, Jessica's eyes dart from $ZOE to Taylor and back to $ZOE... Jessica smiles, almost imperceptibly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hmmm...
The cheerleaders labor through the rest of their push-ups in silence...
After practice, $ZOE watches over Lyle the Lizard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's a good lizard? Who's a good lizard? You are! Yes, you are!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: `Prrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Prrr![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica walks in...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Psst! $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it, Jessica? Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, something `is` wrong. Something has been wrong for some time now.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, something [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] wrong. Something has been wrong for some time now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it me? Did I offend you? I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it's not you, $ZOE. You're too sweet to offend anyone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's Taylor! She's been jealous of you from day one, and now that you've taken away her chance at the Triple Crown, she hates you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor doesn't hate me! She's just upset because I won Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Say what you want, but Taylor `is` worse than ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Say what you want, but Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] worse than ever!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Since when has Taylor been mean to `Keith?!` He's practically a puppy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Since when has Taylor been mean to [color=#3b78e2][i]Keith?![/i][/color] He's practically a puppy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And guy push-ups?! Hello? Last time I checked, most of us aren't guys!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And when was the last time you had double duty, watching Lyle `and` doing laundry?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And when was the last time you had double duty, watching Lyle [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] doing laundry?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not to mention her new pyramid scheme! Boys on the top?! What's next? Ryan in the Lyle mascot suit?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That would make me really uncomfortable...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You said it yourself, `she made Amanda cry!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You said it yourself, [color=#3b78e2][i]she made Amanda cry![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? She's the cheer captain! There's nothing we can do about it except try to be nice to her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gah! You're so nice! Stop it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I can't help it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There `is` something we can do, $ZOE...
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] something we can do, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've already tried giving her lots of cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not talking about cupcakes! When you're at war, you don't have a bake-a-thon!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're at war?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like it or not, we `are.` And the only way to win is to take out the opposition!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like it or not, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are.[/i][/color] And the only way to win is to take out the opposition!

nodes.text: Jessica leans in and lowers her voice...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We have to overthrow Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `WHAT?! WE CAN'T OVERTHROW...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WHAT?! WE CAN'T OVERTHROW...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica cups her hand over $ZOE's mouth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Mmmmff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmmff![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: `Hsss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hsss![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! Quiet down!
Jessica uncovers $ZOE's mouth...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just listen... Imagine actually having `fun` at cheer practice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just listen... Imagine actually having [color=#3b78e2][i]fun[/i][/color] at cheer practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Imagine going an `entire` cheer practice without being insulted...
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine going an [color=#3b78e2][i]entire[/i][/color] cheer practice without being insulted...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never considered that as a possibility...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Imagine not having to worry about what you're eating all the time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eating what I want?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Cheer practice could be just like a party!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, that does sound fun!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm talking about a cheer captain who is way nicer than Taylor... Way `sweeter` too...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm talking about a cheer captain who is way nicer than Taylor... Way [color=#3b78e2][i]sweeter[/i][/color] too...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Me? I... I can't be cheer captain!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: It wouldn't be fair to Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... She `did` make Amanda cry.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... She [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] make Amanda cry.

nodes.text: More silence...
Suddenly, Amanda collapses!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I cried so much I made my arms weak!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't stand this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... One thing about Taylor... She `did` make Amanda cry.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Too bad! You have to do both!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! But that's so mean! And I don't know if I `actually` shrunk Amanda's uniform!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! But that's so mean! And I don't know if I [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] shrunk Amanda's uniform!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We can't be sure, though, can we?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aren't you at least going to apologize to Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't see what for! Whether or not it shrunk doesn't change the fact that she's out of shape!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What shape am I?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't want to know!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Sob! I hope I'm not a rhombus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sob! I hope I'm not a rhombus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, since we'll clearly need to improve our arm strength, we're going to do push-ups! Twenty-five each! And no `girl` push-ups. Real ones!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, since we'll clearly need to improve our arm strength, we're going to do push-ups! Twenty-five each! And no [color=#3b78e2][i]girl[/i][/color] push-ups. Real ones!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: While you're doing those, I'm going to be on the bleachers planning your next exercise! Don't think for a second that I won't be watching you!
Taylor stomps up the bleachers... The cheerleaders slowly bend down and start doing push-ups...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The things I do for love... Oof...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Sob!... Oof... Sob!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sob!... Oof... Sob![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I hate sweating!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I hate that $ZOE won Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, why did you have to win Homecoming Queen, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's not $ZOE's fault, guys... Oof... Don't you see that Taylor's just being cruel?
An awkward silence fills the air as the cheerleaders exchange nervous glances...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one's going to back me up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel so bad for Jessica! But I hate saying anything mean!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: None of you is willing... Oof... To say anything bad about Taylor?
$ZOE buckles! The pyramid teeters...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Keep it steady!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The pyramid's all wrong!
The pyramid collapses in a heap!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ooooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ooooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Be strong, girls!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know I am! But sometimes life is unfair, $ZOE! Not that you would know this from inside your perfect, soapy, Queen bubble!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How fair is it that Howard became Homecoming King?! You don't think that got you extra votes?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about us, huh? Why are you punishing all of us?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How did you vote, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I voted for both of you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And after all I've done for you! Betrayal!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector and Keith! Get up there!
Hector and Keith climb onto the top of the pyramid! The cheerleaders collectively groan beneath the weight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? How is that an insult?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not. $ZOE's paying you a compliment because `she's` nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not. $ZOE's paying you a compliment because [color=#e23b3b][i]she's[/i][/color] nice.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think we can support Hector `and` Keith.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think we can support Hector [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Keith.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I should avoid causing any lasting injuries...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Keith! Run in place! Hector! Get up there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!
Keith starts running in place as Hector climbs onto the top of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It `would` be nice to spend time with the cheerleaders again...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] be nice to spend time with the cheerleaders again...

nodes.text: Jessica leans over from a nearby desk...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too bad Taylor would never allow it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Were we talking to you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All right! Everyone, be quiet for the morning announcements!
Ms. Prez turns off the lights in the classroom and turns on a video monitor.
Justin and Erik appear on-screen in the AV Club room!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore! I'm your president and morning announcement leader, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm on TV!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're also representing the AV Club!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For you jocks, that stands for Audio / Visual.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Our funds are low, and the AV Club could really use more than one camera. The only camera we have is a relic from the '90s that uses video tapes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was a baby in the 90s!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This will help with things like sports highlights, fashion shows, and films for the Drama Club.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Please drop any and all donations off at the front office.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Anything else to add, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes! Did you know Paul Revere was a silversmith?! If he were in the Olympics today, I bet he'd get second place!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And according to a trusted source of mine, first is the worst and second is the best!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There's some ambiguity about third place, but there is speculation that it involves a hairy chest...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I meant about the AV Club...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, nothing to add. Except we sure could use a second camera!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And now, a video from the cheer captain, Taylor.
Taylor appears on-screen in the gym...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hi there, Centerscore! I didn't see you come in!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just wanted to notify the cheerleaders of a special practice after school today...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know at least one of you might have difficulty taking time out of your busy, Queen-like schedule, but...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't be late!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks! And have a great day!
The lights come on, and Ms. Prez begins her lesson for the day...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor would never let me back on the team...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And if she's the captain, I don't even want to be back on it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: $ZOE! Please pay attention!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Ms. Prez...
At cheer practice that day, $ZOE and the rest of the cheerleaders stand on the baseline, while Taylor paces in front of them!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're `not` cheering today!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] cheering today!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No practice?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, there's `still` practice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, there's [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] practice!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How can that be?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Is this a logic puzzle?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! I'm so good at logic puzzles! Bury the survivors in France!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda! Be quiet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're not cheering today because you've all gotten soft!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Instead of working on routines, you are all going to get into the pyramid! Then you're going to do a bunch of strenuous exercises!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Strenuous? But sweating is bad for my complexion!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your complexion doesn't matter! It's not like you're going on any dates anytime soon!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But I'm dating Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quiet down! Everyone into pyramid formation!
Hector and Keith get down on the ground to form the base of the pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? This pyramid structure has gotten stale, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's mix it up!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, Jessica, and Amanda, you can form `the base` of the pyramid. Keith and Hector, you can be on the `top row...` The rest of you fill in the middle!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, Jessica, and Amanda, you can form [color=#3b78e2][i]the base[/i][/color] of the pyramid. Keith and Hector, you can be on the [color=#3b78e2][i]top row...[/i][/color] The rest of you fill in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? But I'm always on the top!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now you're on the bottom! Enjoy your new perspective!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you acting like this, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think you already know, $ZOE! But maybe I should be bowing to you, Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And the rest of you can think about how you voted as we set a record for `longest held pyramid!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the rest of you can think about how you voted as we set a record for [color=#3b78e2][i]longest held pyramid![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now quit stalling! $ZOE, Jessica, Amanda, down! Guys, up!
The girls get down on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's going to be so hard supporting Hector and Keith! Maybe I can convince Taylor to ease up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, you're...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: An attitude change? An attitude change?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am `so` sick of everyone saying I have some kind of attitude problem!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sick of everyone saying I have some kind of attitude problem!

nodes.text: Sam bangs her fist on her desk! Nearby, Ben flinches!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like everyone's just as single-minded as Spencer! Only instead of asking me who they want punched, they tell me I have an attitude problem!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I should be more like him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Please don't punch me! My shoulder can only handle so many Spencers in my life...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Sorry, Ben...
Sam turns back to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I could really use is some girl time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like with the cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it sounds like you're going through a lot, but that you don't really have anyone to talk to about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, that's where girl time comes in! You need to vent, and the cheerleaders love to hear a good rant!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're on in a minute.
Justin and Erik sit on stools in front of the camera. Justin calls to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: When I point to you, put the tape in the player, and it'll play automatically.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If it were anyone but you, I wouldn't do this. But I trust you, $ZOE. You owe me one.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That reminds me... Jessica still owes me for that donut run.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... Justin doesn't seem all that upset with Jessica... Maybe she was just exaggerating their fight...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, by the way, how was your date last night?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What date?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Didn't you have a date with Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wish I'd had a date with her! On our last 'date', I ordered clothes for her online and then she sent me a text that said, 'Thnx dustin lol!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If she wasn't on a date with you, what was she doing?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Who knows?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh... We're on!
The lights dim. Justin and Erik begin broadcasting...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good morning!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just a reminder, the AV Club could still use more donations for that second camera.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now let's begin with a special video compiled by me and $Scott about this winter's 'Secret Santa' program!
As Justin and $Scott's video plays, Justin calls to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Did you say this was filmed yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, why?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It would have been impossible to film this with the AV camera! $Scott and I were filming our announcement video!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, we're on again...
Justin and Erik continue their broadcast...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Welcome back, Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope I'm Sara's Secret Santa!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And now, a special surprise video you'll `all` want to see. It's so exclusive, I haven't even seen it myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: And now, a special surprise video you'll [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] want to see. It's so exclusive, I haven't even seen it myself!

nodes.text: Justin points to $ZOE. She puts the tape in...
It starts to queue up... Suddenly, something clicks in $ZOE's mind...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Justin, when you went on the donut run with Jessica, did anything weird happen?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... I thought it was weird for her to buy `so many` donuts considering the diet you guys are on!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I thought it was weird for her to buy [color=#e23b3b][i]so many[/i][/color] donuts considering the diet you guys are on!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But she didn't eat any of them!
$ZOE has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ha! It `was` Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! It [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh! Here it comes!
Justin looks at the tape in $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's an AV club tape. Jessica must have used our camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... Justin doesn't seem all that upset with Jessica... Maybe she was just exaggerating their fight...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmm, you're better at this than I thought.
Justin looks at the tape in $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, that's an AV Club tape... Mystery cheerleader must have used our camera...
The other cheerleaders surround Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I swear! I haven't been cheating on the diet!
Taylor backs up, bumping into her locker...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait! What's that smell?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What smell?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I smell it too! Oh my gosh! `Donuts! I smell donuts!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I smell it too! Oh my gosh! [color=#3b78e2][i]Donuts! I smell donuts![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Check her locker!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's nothing in there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then you won't mind if we check!
Jessica barges past Taylor and throws open her locker! A tower of donuts falls out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How do you explain this?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Those... Those aren't mine!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They somehow got there by magic?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Donut wizard! `DONUT WIZARD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Donut wizard! [color=#3b78e2][i]DONUT WIZARD![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know how they got there, but I'm `not` cheating on the diet! It's `$ZOE!` $ZOE sabotaged me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know how they got there, but I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] cheating on the diet! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE![/i][/color] $ZOE sabotaged me!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE wouldn't harm a bug, even if it was biting her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! Then it was one of you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And since I don't know which one, practice is canceled!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You've never canceled practice!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I don't know if that's necessary, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are we still cheerleaders?
Taylor storms out of the locker room!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are people going to think about us if we're not cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My reputation!
As the news settles in, Jessica pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can you believe our luck?! Taylor was `actually` cheating on the diet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Can you believe our luck?! Taylor was [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] cheating on the diet!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're done now, right? I mean... We can overthrow her and then clean our hands of this whole mess once and for all, right?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not quite. Maria and Amanda are, of course, still acting like Taylor's drones.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All they care about is their reputations as cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And Hector will probably side with Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there a nice way to make all of them think Taylor's not the best fit for the job?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There is `a` way, but I'll talk to you about it tomorrow, okay? For now, we should just enjoy our success!
nodes.text_bbcode: There is [color=#3b78e2][i]a[/i][/color] way, but I'll talk to you about it tomorrow, okay? For now, we should just enjoy our success!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Success...
Amanda walks over to them.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Hey, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A bunch of the cheerleaders are going to go out tonight to a club... Wanna come?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds like fun, but I'm going on a date with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It totally does! But, um, I'm also going on a date... With Justin...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, you guys should double date!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, yeah! That could be fun!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... No, um, I think Justin wants, like, some time for just us or something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, okay.
The following day, before class starts, Jessica runs excitedly up to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You ready to take the final step in overthrowing Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Every time we take another step, my stomach churns!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Mine too! I'm so excited!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm not! I don't want to spread nasty rumors or sabotage Taylor any more!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to do something `nice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just want to do something [color=#3b78e2][i]nice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, relax! We're, like, completely done with all that mean stuff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes! Last night I filmed a personal message that's like all, '$ZOE is `so` the best! She should be cheer captain!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Totes! Last night I filmed a personal message that's like all, '$ZOE is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] the best! She should be cheer captain!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did? Why would you do something so nice for me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you serious? After spending all this time with you, I realized being sweet has its merits! You did win Homecoming Queen, after all!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, do you know how much better cheering will be for me with you as captain? I'm, like, your biggest supporter!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! That `is` really sweet of you, Jessica...
nodes.text_bbcode: Awww! That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] really sweet of you, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All we have to do is play this tape during the morning announcements, and you're in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you think that will sway Amanda, Hector, and Maria?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, totally!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Once this tape points out how you're actually `more` popular than Taylor, overthrowing her will be a cinch!
nodes.text_bbcode: Once this tape points out how you're actually [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] popular than Taylor, overthrowing her will be a cinch!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why do you need me? Why don't `you` just take it to the AV club?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do you need me? Why don't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] just take it to the AV club?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I totally would! But I got into a huge fight with Justin last night on our date! I'm kind of avoiding him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I promise this is the last thing you have to do...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And then you'll be captain and Sam can come back and we can party with boys in the gym and everyone will be so happy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay. I'll do it.
Jessica hands $ZOE an envelope with a videotape in it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, and Justin's `really` mad at me. You should just avoid mentioning me at all, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, and Justin's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad at me. You should just avoid mentioning me at all, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll keep you out of it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're so sweet!
$ZOE steps into the AV Club room a few minutes before the morning announcements begin...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik! Why are there 'Vote for Sara!' stickers stuck to everything?! The election ended!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not in my heart... Not. In. My. Heart.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If only I had campaigned more. I underestimated the baked goods block!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know about campaigns, Erik. The voters just didn't `know` Sara that well...
nodes.text_bbcode: I know about campaigns, Erik. The voters just didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] Sara that well...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not even sure what she looks like!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She looks exactly like a mermaid without fins!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not helpful... Oh, hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't mind him. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have a tape I'd really like you to play.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmmm... I'm about to go on for the morning announcements, and I usually review all footage beforehand.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's on the tape?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I can't say, only that it's really positive! And that it'll help make Sam happy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And `you're` the one who filmed it?
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] the one who filmed it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... No.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: AV Club policy says we can't run a tape unless we know who filmed it. Who was it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I can't say that either!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? Like a protect your sources kind of thing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or amnesia!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I bet I can guess! You probably don't have a very good poker face! It was another cheerleader, right?
$ZOE can't help but smile!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ha! It was! I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got to stop smiling!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Was it Keith?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maria? Hector?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Amanda? Wait... It couldn't be Amanda... She's incapable of being near a camera without spending the whole time posing for it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Was it Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! That's not saying anything!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, it's saying plenty!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's saying $ZOE did the laundry the $ZOE way...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With integrity!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Perfectly? Are you saying that you're perfect?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think she's saying that!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Is $ZOE bragging?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... Um, I get what she's saying... She's saying that she's certain she didn't make a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's not what she said at all!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That means Taylor `was` cheating on the diet! She's a hypocrite!
nodes.text_bbcode: That means Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] cheating on the diet! She's a hypocrite!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure this one's Taylor's!
$ZOE puts the uniform into the dryer and starts it on the hottest setting...
A couple hours later, $ZOE opens the dryer and pulls out the uniform!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's definitely shrunk! I hope it's the right one!
The next day, before cheer practice...
Jill screams!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE! You shrunk my uniform!
Maria screams!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How many calories do carrots have?!
Amanda screams!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm a giant!
Taylor screams!
Nicole screams!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: After all those push-ups?! How is this possible?!
Jessica comes storming over!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You got the wrong uniform, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The plan was to frame `Taylor,` remember?!
nodes.text_bbcode: The plan was to frame [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor,[/i][/color] remember?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Frame me? Is that what you were up to?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
In practice, $ZOE and Jessica are doing push-ups with Hector and Keith sitting on their backs!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know why... Oof... I ever teamed up with someone... Oof... So incompetent at being bad!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gah! Don't apologize! Be angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Less chatter! More push-ups!
Looks like $ZOE and Jessica are stuck doing push-ups forever!
It seems that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `$ZOE!` What did you do to my uniform?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE![/i][/color] What did you do to my uniform?!

nodes.text: Taylor marches over to $ZOE. Her uniform looks small on her...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Have you been cheating on the diet, Taylor?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I've been eating carrots and celery sticks! What have you been eating, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I miss food!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `have` been sticking to the diet! I mean... I haven't been `perfect,` but I haven't been `this` bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been sticking to the diet! I mean... I haven't been [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect,[/i][/color] but I haven't been [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] bad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It was $ZOE! She messed up my uniform when she did the laundry yesterday! She sabotaged me!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you saying `$ZOE` did this on purpose?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you saying [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] did this on purpose?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE is, like, `a complete angel.`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE is, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]a complete angel.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's true, $ZOE would `never` do something like this!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's true, $ZOE would [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] do something like this!

nodes.text: Jessica turns to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't we get the story from her directly? $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... I did the laundry...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I totally just heard a bunch of the cheerleaders talking about how Taylor is actually a great cheer captain!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the `opposite` of what we wanted! Did you somehow accidentally make Taylor out to be a saint?!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the [color=#3b78e2][i]opposite[/i][/color] of what we wanted! Did you somehow accidentally make Taylor out to be a saint?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! It's just... It's hard to be mean!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! You're lucky I was there! I told them you had just told me all kinds of things about Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? What did you say I said?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing crazy... Just that Taylor made you put lipstick on Lyle the Lizard...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And do team laundry on Christmas Day...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And build an actual pyramid out of bricks for her own 'inspiration'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pretty good, right?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But those are lies!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, come on, she would have made you do those things eventually anyway!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, that's probably true...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Plus now they all think Taylor's the worst!
After school, Jessica runs up to $ZOE in the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Why would that bother us?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, we `are` guys, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] guys, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I hate how often that happens!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Doesn't bother me... I rarely get insulted! It's like water rolling off my butt!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uhh... Is that a saying?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Is now!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't mind either. At least all that rough talk makes me feel more like one of the guys instead of one of the girls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Seriously! If I have to eat one more carrot, I'll puke out of principle!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Last night, I went to a restaurant and ordered a salad... `A salad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Last night, I went to a restaurant and ordered a salad... [color=#e23b3b][i]A salad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It isn't right to keep a man from his food! Taylor needs to re-think who she bosses around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think this is the result Jessica and I wanted!
And in the hallway at the end of the day...
$ZOE walks up to Hector and Keith at Hector's locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Hector! Hi, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What's up, $ZOE, something on your mind?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, guys, I wanted to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't it awful how Taylor...

options.label: Has us on a ridiculous diet?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, what's up with that?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How many times do I have to tell her that I hate sweating?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm always worried I'll turn into a guy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That worked!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's not `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I guess if I had to lose weight somehow, I'd rather eat less than sweat more...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Am I a balloon because I keep eating air?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Even though Taylor's angry, at least she cares enough about us to want us to look better!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That didn't go how I wanted it to...
At the end of practice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pathetic job, everyone! We only did five hundred push-ups!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Get out of my sight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And don't forget to do the team laundry tonight, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...
Later, $ZOE sits next to Maria and Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Maria! Hey, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wanted to go talk to Jacob, but my skin is, like, really gross right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't it awful how Taylor...

options.label: Has us on a ridiculous diet?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awful? Oof... What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're going to get... Oof... So strong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You `like` doing guy push-ups?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] doing guy push-ups?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They give me confidence!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah! Taylor gives us confidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that backfired...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate that!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah! We work harder than anyone at practice, and she `still` calls us names!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! We work harder than anyone at practice, and she [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] calls us names!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I do not look like a blueberry!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And I do not have elephant ears!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think that worked!
The next day, just before cheer practice, Jessica sits down next to $ZOE in the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You ready?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Jessica, I feel bad even `thinking` about overthrowing Taylor! Isn't this wrong?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica, I feel bad even [color=#e23b3b][i]thinking[/i][/color] about overthrowing Taylor! Isn't this wrong?

nodes.text: Sometimes in order to grow flowers, you have to get your hands dirty.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just remember that you're doing this for Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. I just have to remember that it's all for Sam.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then it's settled.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Easy! Step one is to badmouth Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously, again? You're like a broken record!
Jessica sighs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine. Let's try this `one` more time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Let's try this [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] more time...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Right now, all the cheerleaders are `thinking` that Taylor is totally mean!
nodes.text_bbcode: Right now, all the cheerleaders are [color=#3b78e2][i]thinking[/i][/color] that Taylor is totally mean!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But no one's `saying` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: But no one's [color=#3b78e2][i]saying[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The first time anyone really spoke out was when `you` spoke up! She made Amanda cry, and `you` pointed that out!
nodes.text_bbcode: The first time anyone really spoke out was when [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] spoke up! She made Amanda cry, and [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] pointed that out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All you have to do is say out loud what everyone else is already thinking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It sounds mean...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's `honest.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]honest.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm an honest person.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly! If saying what you think is honest, then `not` saying what you think is dishonest!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! If saying what you think is honest, then [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] saying what you think is dishonest!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't want to be dishonest, do you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then go out there and be honest!

nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] funny... I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]dying[/i][/color] of laughter!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Hector made it way more funny. Maybe if I re-told it using 'man' and 'dogg' more...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry, $ZOE. It's not you. I'm just upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What's wrong, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a lot of things...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Swimming doesn't start up again until spring.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then Colt came back, but he came back for Denni...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then last night, I tried to have an actual conversation with Spencer...
Last night, in Sam's room...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some of the guys on the football team were talking about my Halloween costume.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Who? Do you want me to punch them?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax! It was Zach and Phil, and they said that they liked how it looked.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Got it. Punch Zach and Phil.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?! I don't want you to punch anyone! Just have a conversation! Be normal!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Phil then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: By the end of the night, the only person I wanted punched was `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the end of the night, the only person I wanted punched was [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, Sam, I think you could really use...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I totally just heard a bunch of the cheerleaders talking about how Taylor is the worst!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They said she made you put lipstick on Lyle the Lizard...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And do team laundry on Christmas Day...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And build an actual pyramid out of brick for her own 'inspiration'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I didn't say any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's funny how rumors work!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, nice job, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, go me...
